\caption{Computational cost at octree depth 7: retries and wall-clock times in seconds (GPU, after a warm-up) of the successful attempt; in parentheses, the total over all attempts where failed attempts add more than 0.5\%. Solver retries: attempts after the first; mesh retries: failed TetGen calls plus rejected remeshes of the surface the kept mesh was built from (rejections inside unkept size-search trials not counted). Prep.: preparation (Nitsche: boundary conditions, SDF, octree, trimming, solver setup; P1: surface resizing, TetGen, boundary mapping, solver setup). Solve: Newton iteration to relative residual $10^{-6}$; to $10^{-2}$: the same solve until it first reaches $10^{-2}$. Superscripts: \textsuperscript{C}, CPU solve; \textsuperscript{R}, reduced GPU solver; both not comparable with GPU times. Flags, at the session's $h_{\min}$: T, wall thinner than $4h_{\min}$; G, gaps narrower than $h_{\min}$ on over 1\% of the surface; L, a load within $3h_{\min}$ of a support; S, a support piece below $50h_{\min}^2$ or a partial clamp on a section thinner than $4h_{\min}$; blank, unflagged. ---, no body-fitted mesh (the input surface self-intersects). Medians over all objects and over the unflagged ones; $n$, number of values. Time medians are of successful attempts. Details in Section~S\ref{si:error-comparison}.}\label{tab:si-bf-cost-d7}\\

\caption{Computational cost at octree depth 8: retries and wall-clock times in seconds (GPU, after a warm-up) of the successful attempt; in parentheses, the total over all attempts where failed attempts add more than 0.5\%. Solver retries: attempts after the first; mesh retries: failed TetGen calls plus rejected remeshes of the surface the kept mesh was built from (rejections inside unkept size-search trials not counted). Prep.: preparation (Nitsche: boundary conditions, SDF, octree, trimming, solver setup; P1: surface resizing, TetGen, boundary mapping, solver setup). Solve: Newton iteration to relative residual $10^{-6}$; to $10^{-2}$: the same solve until it first reaches $10^{-2}$. Superscripts: \textsuperscript{C}, CPU solve; \textsuperscript{R}, reduced GPU solver; both not comparable with GPU times; $^{\dagger}$, converged only to $10^{-2}$, excluded from the median. Flags, at the session's $h_{\min}$: T, wall thinner than $4h_{\min}$; G, gaps narrower than $h_{\min}$ on over 1\% of the surface; L, a load within $3h_{\min}$ of a support; S, a support piece below $50h_{\min}^2$ or a partial clamp on a section thinner than $4h_{\min}$; blank, unflagged. ---, no body-fitted mesh (the input surface self-intersects). Medians over all objects and over the unflagged ones; $n$, number of values. Time medians are of successful attempts. Details in Section~S\ref{si:error-comparison}.}\label{tab:si-bf-cost-d8}\\
